t: Forging a Digital Steeltrap: Solidifying an AI's Foundation
s: This article details the practical, often unglamorous, process of building a robust AI system by debugging and refactoring its environment, emphasizing the CLI's role as a stable 'home' for agentic work.
sub: AI agentic progress and CLI interaction (Gemini CLI)
Philosophy of 'home' in digital environments (CLI vs. GUI, relativity)
Structuring a momentum plan for AI development (bug fixing, backups, feature sequencing)
Semantic HTML usage: `<menu>` vs. `<nav>` for command lists
